text: Imagine if the Black Death never disappeared...
For centuries, humanity would live in fear of an invisible killer.
And every time people thought it was gone...
A city wakes up to emergency sirens.
People rush to escape, but the roads are already blocked.
And nobody knows who might be infected.
Families are separated behind locked doors.
The streets that once never slept...
Everyone believes the nightmare is finally over.
Then a hospital reports something terrifying.
Within hours, emergency alerts flash across the city.
Humanity has fought the same enemy for centuries.
